tasks.short: Explain and demonstrate safe medical-equipment use and preventive care.

steps.what: Check the device revision and approved operator instructions
Demonstrate operation and preventive care on the medical device
Observe operator practice and correct unsafe handling
Write and check the training completion entry
Commit the accepted completion entry in the learning system

tasks.design: Retain the approved device instructions, live demonstration, return demonstration, actual completion entry and its same-system save in {LMS}. Native linked forms already support this record; after splitting the write and save there is no additional change or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: A training outcome and its device reference may be recorded through separate screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native learning forms can bind the device reference and completion action to a checked entry.
tasks.still_hard: Staff must demonstrate safe handling, not just attend.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unsafe handling and adapt the explanation to the operator.
tasks.altitude: Only completion administration becomes shorter; the repairer retains training responsibilities.

reach.task: Keep a device-specific training completion register
reach.learn: Learning-record fields and competency versus attendance

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: completion forms can reuse a checked device identifier without judging operator competence.

assumptions: Boundary includes explanation, observed practice and its existing completion entry. Operator practice remains unchanged outside the focal denominator; no work is transferred to operators.
Provisional shares apply only where a separate manual completion commit/copy occurs today. If the current form already saves on acceptance, no incremental labour saving is claimed.

s4 repairer supplies operator_id, device_model, instruction_revision, date, trainer_id, outcome and unresolved_training_need. Attendance or competence is never inferred from the calendar. Missing identities are resolved manually within s4.
The device identifier and manufacturer instructions are existing maintenance records. s1 verifies matching revision manually; a native device link is tested before code.
s4 checks the completed entry and learner identity before s5 commits. Any entry edit revokes a1; live instruction has no automatic record write hidden inside it.
unknowns: Which staff record access and consultation requirements apply
research_questions: Can the completion form remove copying while keeping the observed outcome distinct from attendance?

incremental.description: No new configuration; retain the existing completion form

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted completion entry, operator identity and learning-record destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual teaching, outcome capture, checking and the same-system save retain full effort; no new upkeep or benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find compatible repair parts, requisition them and record receipt.

steps.what: Identify the device, failed assembly and required part identifiers
Search approved catalogues for the exact part and available supply
Confirm compatibility, delivery and acceptable source
Prepare the repair-part requisition
Approve the completed requisition for submission
Submit the accepted requisition to purchasing
Inspect the received part and check quantity and identity
Post the checked receipt against the requisition

tasks.design: First configure catalogue links and requisition defaults in {PROCUREMENT} using verified device-part identifiers from the maintenance system in {OTHER}. Native exact-part filters reduce catalogue navigation, while the repairer retains compatibility decisions, final requisition approval and receipt inspection; requisition submission and receipt posting are separate gated actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue and maintenance identifiers are not consistently linked.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved catalogue mappings and controlled requisition forms handle exact identifiers without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Superseded parts and uncertain compatibility need manufacturer confirmation.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a superficially matching part that is unsafe for the device revision.

ambition.what: Keep each installed spare traceable to its approved manufacturer part and receipt.

tasks.altitude: Less catalogue navigation and rekeying; compatibility accountability stays with the repairer.

reach.task: Identify repeat delays from approved spare-part shortages
reach.learn: Part master data and delivery lead-time definitions

evidence.claim: The digest describes Ultimo maintenance records and medical-device work orders, supporting the record context rather than automatic spare compatibility decisions.
Model knowledge: an exact manufacturer part identifier supports deterministic catalogue filtering; ambiguous replacements require human confirmation.

assumptions: Boundary covers repairer part sourcing, requisition and receipt. Buyer's purchase-order approval, external supplier send, delivery and payment remain in their existing workflows; no saving is claimed from them.
Provisional shares assume actual manual catalogue navigation and rekeying. Only 60% of s2 effort is removed; repairer still reads candidate rows. Already-native automation earns no saving.

s1 produces device_id, model_revision, manufacturer_part_id and required_quantity from the actual parts list. Supplier catalogue contains supplier_id, manufacturer_part_id, approved_status, price, currency and availability_date, maintained by purchasing. s1/s3 handle missing IDs and supplier confirmation manually; no automatic substitute inference.

s7 includes physical inspection and capture/check of requisition_id, received_part_id, batch_or_serial, quantity, condition and receipt_date in the mobile maintenance form. Its full labour remains; s8 only posts these accepted facts.
s5 approval binds the final requisition and target buyer queue; s7 approval binds the final receipt payload and quantity. Edits or device/requisition mismatch revoke the respective approval.
unknowns: Who may submit and receipt repair parts
research_questions: Do identifier mappings distinguish manufacturer supersessions and device revisions without unsafe automatic substitutions?

already_counted.description: Read filtered catalogue matches in s2
Verify the final requisition payload within s5

incremental.description: Resolve broken part links and audit receipt mapping

approvals.approved_version: s5 accepted requisition version including part, quantity, cost and buyer queue
s7 checked receipt payload and requisition target; quantity/serial edits revoke approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: 25 catalogue and drafting points minus two focal upkeep = 23; half benefit gives 10.5. Ordering and receipt records retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate installation requirements and install medical equipment to manufacturer specifications.

steps.what: Measure the site and verify available services
Transcribe checked site values and manufacturer limits into the calculation sheet
Calculate power demand and clearance margins
Judge site suitability and accept the installation plan
Install and connect the equipment to the accepted plan
Run commissioning tests and assess results
Write and check the installation and commissioning record
File the accepted record in the maintenance system

tasks.design: First test a protected installation calculator in {SPREADSHEET} with explicit units and manufacturer limits. Retain measurement, input verification, physical installation and commissioning; the repairer writes and checks the final record before its separate filing action in the maintenance system in {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Model-specific values and site measurements require reliable manual capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Protected formulas and versioned manufacturer input tables can remove repeated arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Site defects, electrical safety and commissioning require competent personnel.
tasks.human_edge: Stop an installation when calculated adequacy conflicts with an unsafe site condition.

ambition.what: Attach reproducible power and clearance checks to each commissioning record.

tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic; hands-on work and release responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.task: Review completeness of commissioning calculation records
reach.learn: Units, manufacturer limits and acceptance evidence

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: power and clearance arithmetic can be deterministic once competent staff verify the required values.

assumptions: Boundary covers installation preparation, physical installation and its record. Clinical release to service is a distinct authorised workflow; filing is not release. Shares are provisional.

s1/s2 produce site_voltage, phase, available_current, unit_dimensions, service_clearances, device_power_rating, startup_requirement, units and manufacturer_revision. Repairer measures site values and reads current instructions; uncertain electrical data require competent facilities confirmation within retained preparation effort.

s2 retains all entry and verification time; fixed formulas only apply to a confirmed device/service case. Missing values block calculation, with manual engineering fallback. No language model selects a safety factor.

s4 accepts the completed installation plan before s5. s7 records device_serial, site_id, test_name, observed_value, limit, instrument_id and date and checks the final document before s8. Changes void the relevant approval.
Test native templates before custom code. Only repeated manual arithmetic and a separate record filing action earn savings; already automated calculator runtime earns none.
unknowns: Who can authorise installation and clinical release
research_questions: Does the calculator reject mixed units, missing starting loads and unverified manufacturer revisions?

already_counted.description: Validate completed calculation results within s4

incremental.description: Retest protected formulas and manufacturer input versions

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted installation plan bound to equipment and measured site snapshot
s7 accepted installation record, device serial and maintenance archive destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: ten preparation points minus one upkeep = nine; half benefit gives four. Filing retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate technical specifications and recommend equipment suited to user needs.

steps.what: Define intended use, user requirements and non-negotiable constraints
Obtain current manufacturer specifications for candidate equipment
Extract technical values and qualifications into a comparison matrix

loop.input: Current candidate specification pages and explicit requested fields
loop.output: Field/value/unit/page rows preserving intended-use restrictions and conditional specifications
loop.check: Repairer checks each value and qualification against its source page within s3; absent claims remain unknown and no marketing implication becomes a certified feature
loop.stop: One extraction pass and one correction; unreadable pages or conflicting specifications go to manual extraction
loop.why_not_simpler: Test structured catalogue exports first. Remaining prose and footnoted qualifications cannot be reliably read by fixed column mapping alone.

steps.what: Compare verified values with explicit thresholds and show unresolved criteria
Judge fitness, supportability and practical trade-offs
Write and check the recommendation and unresolved limitations
Commit the checked evaluation report to the purchasing review case

tasks.design: Test structured specification exports first, then use a bounded extraction loop only for unstructured candidate documents in {DOCS}. A controlled {SPREADSHEET} compares verified values with explicit criteria, while the repairer retains suitability judgement and accepts the finished recommendation before a separate commit to {PROCUREMENT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manufacturer specifications mix values, qualifications and marketing prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Page-linked extraction and fixed threshold checks can shorten matrix preparation without choosing equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Real clinical suitability, service support and uncertain claims need investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a technically compliant option that would fail in actual use.

ambition.what: Provide buyers a comparison that explicitly distinguishes failed criteria from missing evidence.

tasks.altitude: Less document transcription and arithmetic; suitability and recommendation authority remain human.

reach.task: Provide technical evidence for equipment replacement priorities
reach.learn: Specification traceability and lifecycle support constraints

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked extraction can assist specification transcription; it does not establish clinical suitability.

assumptions: Boundary covers technical evaluation and an internal recommendation record. Purchase authorisation and supplier contact are separate downstream work, with no savings claimed. Shares are provisional.

s1 captures criterion_id, required_value, unit, hard_constraint and intended_use from the repairer's discussion with users. Full discussion and capture remain. Missing thresholds are resolved manually, not inferred.

s2 obtains document_id, device_model, revision and publication_date. s3 produces field_name, value, unit, qualification, source_page and unknown_flag with counted verification; a missing or contradictory field blocks a positive comparison.
s4 uses explicit comparisons only; no weighted ranking or suitability judgement is automated. s5 evaluates qualifications and unresolved evidence at full time.

s6 checks the finished report, caveats and case destination after all content exists. Any document, criterion or report edit invalidates a1. Native export and comparison tools precede custom extraction.
research_questions: Can the extractor preserve footnoted exclusions that would reverse a technical comparison?

already_counted.description: Verify extracted specification values and qualifications in s3
Check completed report and case destination within s6

incremental.description: Audit extraction failures and maintain comparison field definitions

approvals.approved_version: s6 accepted final evaluation report and purchasing case identifier

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: eight extraction plus 15 comparison points minus two upkeep = 21; half benefit gives 9.5. Committing the written record retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce rekeying and technical comparison work while retaining safe equipment demonstrations, compatibility checks and commissioning.
reach: Help the maintenance supervisor connect device identifiers, approved spares and commissioning evidence.
role.ambitious_version: A repairer whose equipment advice and maintenance records are easier to verify, with professional safety decisions preserved.
